messages.title: You're reading the new Despia docs
messages.body: The link you followed pointed to our legacy documentation, so we brought you to the page that replaces it. The legacy docs are only for apps on a legacy deployment. We recommend moving every app to the modern version: a typed API, more features and better performance.
